name: Heat Pump (air / water)
description: An air / water heat pump outdoor unit (monobloc) with its controller - reference Vaillant aroTHERM plus (12 kW class, R290, heating and cooling). Flow / return / outdoor temperature, water flow, heat output and counter, electric power and counter, fan speed, an on / off switch. Used by heating-control.

models.name: aroTHERM plus VWL 125/6 A (12 kW)
models.purpose: Air / water monobloc heat pump - heats (and cools) the water of the heating circuit from the outdoor air.

specs.label: Interface
specs.value: Modbus TCP via the system controller
